outcome: Plasma levels of b-human chorionic gonadotropin
cohort: Patients suffering from scarred uterus caused by previous cesarean section surgery.
finding: Resveratrol treatment significantly reduced uterus scarring in the majority of patients (87.36%) compared with the control, downregulated plasma levels of b-human chorionic gonadotropin, promoted uterus remodeling and endometrium regeneration, and improved pregnancy outcomes.
